main_text.l: REVELATIO Antichristi, pro aperto eius tyrannidis exercitio,2 Thess.2.3.8. reuelatio secundi aduentus Christi à fidelibus expectatur,1 Corinth.1.7. reuelationes & visiones,Iosu.5.13.1 Reg.17.9.2 Machab.3.24. & 5.2.& 10.& 11.8. Reuelationum Dei peculiarium exempla, Vide APARITIONVM Dei, &c. Reuelationum genera peculiaria olim duo fuerunt,Num.12.6.V. Act.2.17.& 2 Corinth.12.7.
REVERENTIA, est dignitatis superiorisque potestatis agnitio & veneratio, quam & animo & corpore exhibere inferiores debent,Leuit.19.3.V.Liberorum,& aliorum officium.

REVERENTIA erga alios praecipitur, Rom.12.10. Phil.2. 1 Pet.5.5. Vide HONOS. Reuerentiae exempla: Rex Israel Reg.6.v.21.22. Discipuli,Marci 9.32.Elizabeth, Luc.1. populus,9.45.Actor.5.13. Ecclesia Gentium,20.37.& 21. Paulus,26.25.V.HONOR.

REX:Rex qualis,& quorsum constituendus,Deut.17.15. Rex iustus,regni stabilimentum,Prou.29.4. à Deo est,1 Sam.12.13.1 Reg.10.9. honore afficiendus, Rom 13.1.&c.1 Pet.2.17. Legem legere debet,Deut.17.v.18.19.equos sibi multiplicare non debet, v.16. Rex seculorum immortalis,1 Tim.1.17.

REGIS cor in manu Domini,Prou.21.1.Regis ira periculosa,16.14.& 19.12. Regis irae exempla:Ioas,2 Paral.24.21.. Nebuchodonosor,Dan.2.v.5.12. Reges inaugurandi & concrandi formula,Vide PRECATIONVM formulae:&,PRINCIPES inaugurandi.
main_text.p: Reges ac Principes religionis curam suscipere debent. Exempla:Dauid, 2 Sam.6.2.& 72. Iosaphat,2 Par.17.7. 19.3.Ezechias,29.5. Iosia,34.8. (Vide MAGISTRATUS & eorum officia.) Reges mortalis suae conditionis monefieri debent, Psalm.82.7. Reges ac Principes non facile cedunt. Exempla: Dauid 2 Sam.19.29.1 Paral.21. Roboam,2 Paral 10.8.Asa.16.10. Amasias,25.16. Ozias,26.19.Iosias,35.22.Sedechias,36.v.12.13. Ioacim, Iere.36. Herodes, Mar.6.17. Reges interdum clientum suorum metu indigna committunt. Exempla: Darius,Dan.6. Reges ob populi peccata mutantur,Prou.28.2. reges qui facere quidve fugere debeant,Deut.17.19.1 Sam.8.1.&c. regum 2.2.&c.&10.9.2 Paral.9.1.&19.5.Iob.34.30. Psal.10.&40.

page.notes: Right edge partly obscured by show-through from the facing page; words cut off there are marked as far as legible. Some numerals in the index are faint and uncertain, particularly in the Regis and Reges entries.
